# One set of books for every marketplace you sell on.

> Free private tool for resellers: drop your eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Whatnot and Shopify reports and get one monthly profit and loss, what each channel really keeps, and a Schedule C style worksheet. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
